capabilities.description: Records ice temperature readings, keeps them in time order, and checks whether the ice has stayed too warm for long enough. If it has, the next upcoming skating session is put on hold.
capabilities.name: Ice condition monitoring and automatic session hold

capabilities.description: A manager can cancel a session that is on hold, and every paid ticket is refunded through the payment provider. Refunds are idempotent, and the code guards against two cancellations running at once. A manager can also lift the hold so ticket sales start again.
capabilities.name: Cancelling held sessions with ticket refunds

capabilities.description: Sends text messages to ticket holders, for example when their session is put on hold, through an SMS provider. Delivery failures are reported.
capabilities.name: Ticket holder text notification

capabilities.description: Creates payment checkouts with an external payment provider and checks and normalises the provider's response.
capabilities.name: Online ticket payment checkout

capabilities.description: Stores skating sessions and returns the schedule for a date range, ordered by date and start time.
capabilities.name: Session schedule management
